competing_process.interpretation: A separate rendered full-reach Unreal capture was active throughout both measurements. Its sustained CPU activity and commandlet-rendering flags make the host non-isolated; no absolute GPU or wall-clock result from the overlap may qualify a release or establish a product regression.

corrective_actions.macos_preflight: unreal/Scripts/build_mac_rc.sh now fails before packaging and again immediately before the player-presentation soak if any Unreal Editor or RaftSim packaged runtime is already running.
corrective_actions.windows_preflight: unreal/Scripts/build_win_rc.ps1 applies the equivalent fail-closed process isolation checks.
corrective_actions.automation_lifecycle: Unattended command-line environment automation now requests process exit after success or failure even when an older invocation omits RaftSimExitAfterEnvironmentAutomation; interactive editor invocations remain open.
corrective_actions.renderer_profile_lock: Both platform workflows explicitly apply and live-verify the intended post-travel renderer profile; the macOS soak reuses the successfully created fresh-profile UserDir, and Windows now does the same.
corrective_actions.required_replacement: Run a new normal-window packaged Shipping soak from exact-current sources only after all competing Unreal/game processes have exited.
